DECEPTION.Definition: tricking people into believing things that are not true

PROXY-WAR.Definition: a war in which two powers fight each other indirectly, through other people

NICHE.Definition: of interest to only a small number of people

SPYMANSHIP.Definition: the skill of secretly collecting information about rivals

EXPANSE.Definition: a large open area of land

BUFFER.Definition: acting as a protective zone between two rivals

FOOTHOLD.Definition: a secure first position from which to gain more influence

BASE.Definition: the main place from which they operated

WILDERNESS.Definition: a remote, empty area with few people and no towns

DISGUISE.Definition: clothing and changes to his appearance that hid who he really was

OBEDIENCE.Definition: willingness to do what he was told

PUPPET.Definition: controlled by others, with no real authority of his own

EXILE.Definition: a state of being forced to live outside his own country

UPRISING.Definition: a violent rebellion by people against those in power

STATIONED.Definition: sent to live and work in a place as part of his duties

OFFENCE.Definition: anger and upset caused by something seen as rude or wrong

DOWNFALL.Definition: the cause of his ruin and death

MOB.Definition: a large, angry and violent crowd

STORMED.Definition: attacked and forced its way into

COMPOUND.Definition: a group of buildings with a wall or fence around them

CHARM.Definition: a pleasant manner that made people like him

BLINDFOLD.Definition: a piece of cloth tied over the eyes so that a person cannot see

CURRY FAVOUR.Definition: win support by pleasing or flattering people

FACTIONS.Definition: small groups within a larger political group who share particular aims

BIDED THEIR TIME.Definition: waited patiently for the right moment
